mentions.name: next-ai-draw-io
mentions.description: Open-source tool that lets you co-draw diagrams with an LLM inside draw.io/diagrams.net. The AI edits the real draw.io XML rather than generating a static picture, so the model and user share the same canvas: it can rough out AWS/GCP/Azure architectures, then the user keeps working in the normal editor (dragging boxes, renaming) while issuing chat commands like "clean this up", "split this service out", or "add a read replica here". It can rebuild a diagram from a screenshot or PDF and iterate via chat plus manual edits, supports uploading PDFs/text to turn existing docs into diagrams, and offers bring-your-own API keys for multiple LLM providers.
